title: Crunchyroll Reveals Packed Fall 2026 English Dub Schedule for October (With Big Returns & Debuts)
content: The Fall 2026 anime season is fast approaching, and Crunchyroll has revealed their packed schedule of English dub releases that will be kicking off this October. With the final few episodes of the Summer 2026 anime season airing over these next two weeks, it’s time to already look ahead to what’s to come for the Fall…
author: ComicBook

title: Re:ZERO Looks Back at Season 1 Through 4 in New Lyric Video Featuring "Recollect" by Konomi Suzuki and Ashnikko
content: Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World- has released a special lyric video for “Recollect” by Konomi Suzuki featuring Ashnikko looking back at the anime from Season 1 to Season 4. The TV anime by studio White Fox began with Season 1, running from April to September 2016.
author: Anime Corner

title: Uta Macross Rhythm Game Meets Crowdfunding Goal for Offline Version
content: The crowdfunding campaign for Uta Macross , a "revival" version of the Macross franchise 's first rhythm game Uta Macross : Smartphone De Culture , reached its 30,000,000 yen (about US$190,000) goal within the first hour of launching on September 10, and also reached all of its initial stretch goals.
author: ANN

title: Katekyo Hitman Reborn! Anime Reveals Ninth Ending Featuing "Suberidai" by Mori Tsubasa
content: Katekyo Hitman REBORN! anime has officially released the creditless version of its ninth ending, featuring the song “Suberidai” by Mori Tsubasa. The song was used in Episodes 102-114, while the new video was released as part of the series’ 20th anniversary celebration.
author: Anime Corner

title: Sword Art Online Author Reki Kawahara's Devils' Crest Anime Casts 4 Classmates
content: The official website for Devils' Crest , the television anime of Reki Kawahara 's Demons' Crest novel series, announced the cast members for four classmates of the protagonist Yuma Ashihara on Wednesday: Yūsuke Kobayashi as Teruki Sugamo, a student council member and soccer club captain Maaya Uchida as Aria Misono,…
author: ANN

title: Shangri-La Frontier Season 3 Announces January 10 Debut, Half-Year Run
content: The official website for the third television anime season based on Katarina 's Shangri-La Frontier web novel series revealed on Wednesday the season's new key visual, January 10 premiere, and a broadcast run of two continuous cours (quarter of a year) on MBS , TBS and 26 affiliated channels at 5:00 p.m.
author: ANN

title: France's Ankama Presents Fantasy TV Anime Aoki Denshō Welsh & Shedar
content: A website opened on Wednesday for Aoki Denshō Welsh & Shedar (The Azure Legend: Welsh & Shedar), the original television anime by French entertainment company Ankama which will premiere on October 2 on Tokyo MX at 9:25 p.m. JST (8:25 a.m. EDT).
author: ANN

title: 'Demons' Crest' Announces Additional Cast
content: The official website for the original net anime adaptation of Reki Kawahara 's Demons' Crest light novel announced additional cast on Wednesday. The anime is scheduled to premiere on Amazon Prime Video on November 6.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Shangri-La Frontier Season 3 Key Visual Revealed, Two Consecutive Cours Starting on January 10, 2027
content: Shangri-La Frontier Season 3 revealed the first key visual, confirming two consecutive cours and a January 10, 2027 premiere date. The anime is set to continue with the Galaxia Heroes: Chaos action, which was previously teased in a trailer . Studio C2C is again in charge of the animation.
author: Anime Corner

title: Entergram Announces Vtuber Azusa Honami's Azure Memoria Game
